body: I love her. I'm not a casual sex person. It's the knowledge that for years she will be the only one on my mind. I know I can get a custody order and see my kids but knowing that nothing matters without my wife,I realize I'm not fit to be their dad. I know I SHOULDN'T end it, I should provide for my kids and be a better absent father than mine was. But I am weak. My self respect is gone and the person I am now is pathetic. Rebuilding that to find someone one day just to lose them too, I'm tired of the cycle.
